personal.title: Frontend Engineer & Creative Technologist
personal.tagline: I build interfaces that feel like experiences.
personal.bio: Frontend engineer with 6+ years building high-impact web products. I specialize in React, Next.js, and complex animations — turning design ideas into fast, memorable digital experiences. Co-founder of Cebratica, where I combine technical precision with strategic design thinking.
about: Frontend engineer with 6+ years crafting high-impact web products. I specialize in React, Next.js, and complex web animations — the place where clean code meets visual craft.
Co-founder of Cebratica, a studio where I combine strategic design thinking with frontend engineering to build digital products that actually move people.
I care deeply about performance, accessibility, and that feeling when everything just works. I've shipped products for CaixaBank, Roca, Guia Repsol and startups across three continents.

experience.description: Built and run a design-and-development studio from the ground up. I own the full frontend stack — from design system to deployment — while aligning technical decisions with brand strategy for each client.
highlights: Co-founded the studio and led all technical architecture decisions
Delivered high-end web projects for premium clients across Spain and LATAM
Developed a proprietary component system powering multiple client sites
Closed and managed accounts independently, from proposal to delivery

experience.description: In charge of AI strategy and implementation across the team. I define how we integrate LLMs and automation into our workflows — from client delivery to internal tooling — and I train and guide the team on using AI effectively.
highlights: Lead AI adoption for the full team — tools, workflows and training
Built automation pipelines that cut content production time by ~60%
Integrated LLM workflows into client delivery and project management processes
Prototyped AI-first internal tools used daily by the studio

experience.description: Led frontend development for CaixaBank's international digital platforms across 6 European markets. Coordinated a distributed team, set code quality standards, and shipped features used by millions of banking customers.

Led Private Banking, Premier Banking and Wealth Management Luxembourg products
